name: Eraclito Limit Product Quantity
author: alessio.rosi

sections.description:
Eraclito Limit Product Quantity lets you set a maximum quantity for each WooCommerce product in a single order. Perfect for products with limited availability, special offers, or to prevent bulk purchases.

Features

  • Custom limit for each product
  • Quantity input capped on the product page, with an informative notice
  • Cart validation: excess quantities are reduced to the allowed maximum, with a clear message
  • Works with the Cart and Checkout blocks (Store API)
  • Limit column in the admin products list
  • Compatible with High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS)
  • English interface, Italian translation included

Use cases

  • Limit purchases of products on sale
  • Manage products with limited stock
  • Prevent bulk purchases from resellers
  • Control the distribution of exclusive products

Requires WooCommerce 5.0 or higher. Tested with WooCommerce 11.3.1.

More plugins by Eraclito

  • Pause Sales for WooCommerce – pause WooCommerce sales and show a custom banner message to your customers.
  • Payment Method Order Column – add a payment method column to the WooCommerce orders list, with filtering and sorting.
  • Woocommerce Poste Delivery Business PRO – integrate Poste Italiane Delivery Business shipping and tracking into WooCommerce.
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin from the WordPress plugin directory, or upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin from the Plugins menu. WooCommerce must be installed and active.
  3. Edit a product and open the General tab of Product data.
  4. Set the “Maximum quantity per order” field and save the product.
sections.faq:
Does it work with all product types?

Yes, with simple products, variable products and all product types supported by WooCommerce.

What happens if a customer already exceeds the limit in the cart?

The quantity is automatically reduced to the maximum allowed and a message is shown.

Can I set different limits for different products?

Yes, every product can have its own limit. Products without a limit are not restricted.

Does the limit apply across multiple orders?

No, the limit applies to a single order. Customers can place more separate orders.

How do I remove the limit from a product?

Leave the “Maximum quantity per order” field empty and save the product.
